title: Anaya, 16:
title_short: Anaya · People Are on Your Side
headline: The adults who keep showing up for a 16-year-old, right down to the volunteer who remembered her style.
story: Anaya is 16 and in 11th grade. She opens with the idea: something steady in her life keeps showing her that people are on your side and always willing to fight for you. Her program has been with her since 8th grade. Sailing, golfing, friends she still has: she found her community in Minnesota.

Then today: a volunteer at the event knew her from her back-to-school shoes at Foot Locker. He remembered her style and found it for her here. The shoes were a match made in heaven. She holds them up and smiles. Warm and positive, about the adults who show up.
